deep.reconstruction:
Setting: E, F are Hilbert spaces and L_0(E,F) is the compact operators. ρ_i(u) are the singular values s_i(u) in decreasing order. For a trace-class or finite-rank T, α_m(T) = Tr Λ^m T is the m-th coefficient of det(1+rT) in r. For |T| this gives α_m(|T|) = ||Λ^m T||_1 = e_m(s_1(T), s_2(T), ...), the elementary symmetric function of the singular values. On the previous page Grothendieck defined σ_n^m(w) = e_m(ρ_1(w), ..., ρ_n(w)), the elementary symmetric function of the n largest singular values. He also proved Corollary 2, ||Λ^m(u+v)||_1 ≤ Σ_p ||Λ^p u||_1 ||Λ^{m-p} v||_1, via ||Λ^p u ∧ Λ^q v||_1 ≤ (p!q!/(p+q)!) ||Λ^p u||_1 ||Λ^q v||_1. Theorem 2 extends this to compact operators truncated at n: (16) σ_n^m(u+v) ≤ Σ_{p=0}^m σ_n^p(u) σ_n^{m-p}(v). Equivalently (15): ∏_{i≤n}(1+rρ_i(u+v)) ≤ ∏_{i≤n}(1+rρ_i(u)) ∏_{i≤n}(1+rρ_i(v)) for every r ≥ 0.

This page proves (16) through a variational principle.

Prop 3 (numbered (18)) states that for u ∈ L_0(E,F):
σ_n^m(u) = sup{ |α_m(vu)| : v ∈ L(F,E), ||v|| ≤ 1, rank v ≤ n } = sup α_m(|vu|).

Proof of ≤ sup: by a Lemma, for u ∈ L(E,E) of rank ≤ n, |α_m(u)| ≤ α_m(|u|) ≤ σ_n^m(u).
- Let w be the restriction of u to the invariant subspace u(E), which has dimension ≤ n. Then w = α* u α with α: u(E) → E the inclusion.
- u and w have the same nonzero eigenvalues, so α_m(u) = α_m(w).
- The Weyl–Horn majorization gives |e_m(λ(w))| ≤ e_m(s(w)).
- Finally s_i(w) ≤ ||α*|| ||α|| s_i(u) ≤ s_i(u).
For general v with ||v|| ≤ 1 and rank ≤ n, vu has rank ≤ n and s_i(vu) ≤ s_i(u). This gives |α_m(vu)| ≤ σ_n^m(vu) ≤ σ_n^m(u).

Attainment: assume dim E ≥ n and take the Schmidt decomposition u = Σ ρ_i ē_i ⊗ f_i. Choose v = Σ_{i≤n} f_i ⊗ e_i (a partial isometry). Then vu = Σ_{i≤n} ρ_i ē_i ⊗ e_i and α_m(vu) = σ_n^m(u). He remarks that if F = E and u is hermitian, v can be taken to be a rank-n orthogonal projector.

Proof of (16): take any w with ||w|| ≤ 1 and rank ≤ n. Then
|α_m(w(u+v))| ≤ α_m(|wu+wv|) ≤ Σ_p α_p(|wu|) α_{m-p}(|wv|), using Corollary 2 (14).
By Prop 3, α_p(|wu|) ≤ σ_n^p(u) and α_{m-p}(|wv|) ≤ σ_n^{m-p}(v). Taking the sup over w and applying Prop 3 again gives (16).

The purpose is a sharp perturbation theory for Fredholm determinants and singular values of compact operators on Hilbert space. Concretely, it gives subadditivity of log ∏(1+r s_i) under addition, refined to the level of coefficients. The next page goes on to formulate det ∏(1+ρ_i(u)) = sup_{||v|| ≤ 1} |det(1+vu)|.
errors: The concluding phrase 'd'où la formule (18)' should read (16): what has just been proved is the coefficient inequality of Theorem 2, and (18) is Prop 3 itself, which was used as input.
The step |α_m(T)| ≤ α_m(|T|) (Weyl–Horn majorization |e_m(λ)| ≤ e_m(s)) is used without proof or reference; it is standard (Weyl 1949, Horn 1950).
The attainment construction tacitly needs dim E ≥ n (noted) and u to have at least n Schmidt terms, otherwise padding with zeros. These are minor gaps.

ideas.what: Variational formula: σ_n^m(u) = e_m(s_1..s_n) equals the sup of |Tr Λ^m(vu)| over contractions v of rank ≤ n.
ideas.modern_name: Ky Fan-type maximum principle for elementary symmetric functions of singular values
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ky Fan (1951) for sums of singular values; the elementary-symmetric version appears in Gohberg–Krein-type treatments / Marshall–Olkin
ideas.where_published: possibly related remarks in 'La théorie de Fredholm' (Bull. SMF 1956); unsure

ideas.what: Truncated subadditivity ∏_{i≤n}(1+r s_i(u+v)) ≤ ∏_{i≤n}(1+r s_i(u)) ∏_{i≤n}(1+r s_i(v)), with the refined coefficientwise inequality (16).
ideas.modern_name: Rotfel'd inequality / Seiler–Simon determinant inequality det(1+|A+B|) ≤ det(1+|A|)det(1+|B|) (coefficient form)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Ky Fan / Gohberg–Krein (1960s), S. Rotfel'd (1967–69), Seiler–Simon (1975)
ideas.where_published: unsure; not to my knowledge in Produits tensoriels topologiques or the Fredholm paper in this form

ideas.what: Lemma: for a rank ≤ n operator, |Tr Λ^m u| ≤ e_m of its top n singular values, via compression to u(E).
ideas.modern_name: Weyl–Horn majorization plus the compression inequality s_i(P u P) ≤ s_i(u)

missed.claim: In 1953 Grothendieck proved, by an exterior-algebra method, the coefficientwise inequality e_m(s_{≤n}(u+v)) ≤ Σ_p e_p(s_{≤n}(u)) e_{m-p}(s_{≤n}(v)) for compact operators. This is a strengthening of what is now cited as the Rotfel'd / Seiler–Simon inequality det(1+|A+B|) ≤ det(1+|A|)det(1+|B|), roughly 14–22 years before those standard citations. He derives it from a variational principle for e_m that generalizes Ky Fan's maximum principle.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is a priority and history point for the trace-ideal and Fredholm-determinant literature (Simon's Trace Ideals credits Seiler–Simon). The mathematics itself is now standard, but Grothendieck's early, essentially complete Hilbert-space determinant theory is not credited.

deep.surprise_reason: The page contains a correct, complete proof of a determinant/singular-value inequality later attributed to Rotfel'd and Seiler–Simon, in a coefficientwise and truncated form, which gives early priority. The results are now well known, though, and similar Ky Fan-type statements existed by the early 1950s, so specialists would be only mildly surprised.
transcription_corrections: 'f_i(vu)', 'f_i(u)', 'f_i(w)' should read ρ_i(vu), ρ_i(u), ρ_i(w) (singular values), consistent with the previous page.
'u = Σ f_i ē_i ⊗ f_i' should read u = Σ ρ_i ē_i ⊗ f_i, and 'vu = Σ f_i ē_i ⊗ e_i' should read Σ ρ_i ē_i ⊗ e_i.
First line: 'On va prouver la propriété ft analogue' is likely 'On va prouver une propriété analogue' or 'la propriété suivante'; the superscript 'ft' is uncertain.
Final 'd'où la formule (18)' is written as (18) on the page, but (16) is meant logically.
